prompt:
Photograph from deep inside a dark sea cave. Through a jagged opening in
the upper centre, a bright glimpse of the sea and a distant sailing
ship. On the right, the skeleton of a long-dead pirate hangs from the
cave ceiling by its two wrists tied together: both wrist bones are
locked side by side in one heavy iron shackle, and a very short iron
chain of a few links joins that shackle to an iron ring in the rock
right above it. Its long arms are stretched straight up in a narrow V
from the shoulders to the bound wrists, and the skull hangs far below
the hands, between the shoulders, bare, with nothing touching it. It is
dressed in a ragged shirt and long ragged trousers that cover its leg
bones down to the ankles; only the bony feet show below the trouser
hems, dangling above the rocks. The rest of the cave, especially the
left half and the bottom, is rock in deep darkness. Dramatic
chiaroscuro, realistic textures, sharp focus. Style: one consistent look for the whole series, photographed like a
period film still of the 1660s Caribbean, natural warm light, gentle
film grain, muted rich colours with warm amber and deep teal tones,
moderate contrast, shallow depth of field, realistic textures, no text.
